selection_policy.primary_quality_bar: prefer the coarsest candidate whose worst-cell p95 vertical reconstruction error remains <= 0.15 m
selection_policy.reason: 2 m meets the realism threshold on all five cells while reducing grid vertices by 4x versus 1 m; 4 m exceeds the threshold
selection_policy.height_runtime_gate: building heights remain blocked until second-authoritative-source validation

notes: The selected 2 m resolution is a terrain candidate only; it does not approve DSM-DTM building heights.
Maximum single-pixel errors remain several metres near sharp discontinuities, so hero/photo-match locations may request the 1 m fallback when visual comparison demonstrates need.
No terrain or height is invented where the official source is NoData.
